prompt: The client wants to know which products earn the weakest margins. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Bottled water earns the best margin, at 60%
options.feedback: True, but the question is which products have the weakest margins.

options.text: Lattes earn the highest margin of all the drinks
options.feedback: Lattes earn 30%, the lowest of the drinks; bottled water earns 60%.

options.text: Pastries earn far less margin than any drink
options.feedback: Right. Pastries earn 10%, against 30–60% for the drinks.
The chart shows margins, not sales. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: Pastries earn 10%, against 30–60% for the drinks.
